prompt: Subtitle track over the video `media/intro.mp4` (30s): five captions at given times, with a progress bar. The presentation starts from a Start button. The entry file is `main.eligian` in the current directory; `media/intro.mp4` is already there. The presentation starts on a timeline named `Start` that shows the button `#start`; clicking `#start` switches to the video timeline, named `Video`, which plays `media/intro.mp4`. The captions are the elements `#caption-1` to `#caption-5`, each visible only within its time range on `Video` and hidden outside it: `#caption-1` from 2s to 7s, `#caption-2` from 8s to 13s, `#caption-3` from 14s to 19s, `#caption-4` from 20s to 25s, `#caption-5` from 26s to 29s. The progress bar is the element `#progress`. An element counts as hidden when it or an ancestor has the `hidden` attribute or computes `display: none`, `visibility: hidden` or `opacity: 0` from your CSS; otherwise it is visible.
